I'm a bioinformatician at USC. I build **reproducible reanalysis pipelines** and
**interactive data portals** that let biologists explore published and in-house
sequencing datasets, and I work on **population and evolutionary genomics** in
marine invertebrates.

My work spans two threads:

- **Reanalysis & data portals** — turning raw RNA-seq, spatial, and multiplex
  imaging datasets into password-gated web portals that collaborators can query
  without touching the command line.
- **Genomics pipelines** — variant calling, de novo mutation detection, and
  population-structure analysis with GATK, BWA, SAMtools, and friends.

See [Projects](projects.qmd) for the details, or my
[GitHub](https://github.com/rachelzh-hua) for the code.

## Focus areas

- Reproducible RNA-seq & spatial-omics reanalysis
- De novo mutation rate estimation (trio sequencing)
- Population genomics of marine invertebrates
- Building shareable, interactive reports for wet-lab collaborators

## Toolbox

`GATK4` · `BWA` · `SAMtools` · `Picard` · `VCFtools` · `PLINK` · `ADMIXTURE`
· `SnpEff` · `RepeatMasker` · `R` · `Python` · `Quarto` · `Vercel`
